item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Honey-mustard glazed smoked pork loin accompanied by classic creamed potatoes and a crisp slaw of seasonal apples and mustard. (1+2+6+11+13) GREEN DISH: Dish Honey-mustard glazed celeriac accompanied by classic creamed potatoes and a crisp slaw of seasonal apples and mustard. (1+2+6+10+11+13)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Coq au vin, a classic French dish with chicken braised in a rich red wine sauce with vegetables, served with creamy mashed potatoes and topped with fresh parsley. Served with a green salad and mustard vinaigrette on the side. (6+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Coq au vin with cauliflower braised in a rich red wine sauce with vegetables, served with creamy mashed potatoes and topped with fresh parsley. Served with a green salad and mustard vinaigrette on the side. (6+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Glazed ham with creamed kale and browned potatoes. (6+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Glazed celeriac with creamed kale and browned potatoes. (6+10+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Chili con carne, spicy and warming for early November. (6+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish GREEN DISH: sin carne, the vegetarian version, just as spicy and warming. (6+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Lamb chana with naan topped with namkeen. Served with Indian rice salad, yoghurt, chilli sauce, coriander and lime pickle. (1+6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu chana with naan topped with namkeen. Served with Indian rice salad, yoghurt, chilli sauce, coriander and lime pickle. (1+6+7+15)
